usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.usage.audio_transcriptions.list(start_time: 1, end_time: 1, bucket_width: "1m", project_ids: ["string"], user_ids: ["string"], api_key_ids: ["string"], models: ["string"], group_by: ["project_id"], limit: 1, page: "page")
pp result

typeReference.signature: client.admin.organization.usage.audio_transcriptions.list(start_time:, end_time: nil, bucket_width: nil, project_ids: nil, user_ids: nil, api_key_ids: nil, models: nil, group_by: nil, limit: nil, page: nil) -> Page<Models::UsageTimeBucket>

fields.name: start_time
fields.description: Start time (Unix seconds) of the query time range, inclusive.

fields.name: end_time
fields.description: End time (Unix seconds) of the query time range, exclusive.

fields.name: bucket_width
fields.description: Width of each time bucket in response. Currently `1m`, `1h` and `1d` are supported, default to `1d`.

fields.name: project_ids
fields.description: Return only usage for these projects.

fields.name: user_ids
fields.description: Return only usage for these users.

fields.name: api_key_ids
fields.description: Return only usage for these API keys.

fields.name: models
fields.description: Return only usage for these models.

fields.name: group_by
fields.description: Group the usage data by the specified fields. Support fields include `project_id`, `user_id`, `api_key_id`, `model` or any combination of them.

fields.name: limit
fields.description:
Specifies the number of buckets to return.
- `bucket_width=1d`: default: 7, max: 31
- `bucket_width=1h`: default: 24, max: 168
- `bucket_width=1m`: default: 60, max: 1440

fields.name: page
fields.description: A cursor for use in pagination. Corresponding to the `next_page` field from the previous response.
